constraints.live_authorization: Required: actual current S0/71 permit + current owner releases including 72/73/74/45 for affected shared files; does not arise from this artifact
constraints.parallel_author_limit: min(19, actual live actors with nonoverlapping bounded leases); no self-approval of FINAL
constraints.source_drift: Source-current C and writer footprints must be reconciled at launch, never infer from planning pin
constraints.pilot: P0 U11.title-save and P1 U13.pr-approval distinct, with Q01/Q02; P0 not C12 receipt or approval
constraints.canonical_gates: All original 1610 criteria and 3 FINAL roles, P03, M31/MI07, real scanner and installed web+desktop retained

admission_rule: I00 owns preflight and freezes exact contract/surface/component/copy blob digests, material C/tree and authenticated external S0/71/45/72/73/74 authority with writer releases. Then each order/output receives a bounded lease for owns under current HEAD. Until then read-only only. No worker redesigns contracts.
scheduling_rule: First wave C00 + up to 19 disjoint writers; P0 title-save authored separately from P1 approval. Release ARTIFACT_READY with validated receipt and run transitive consumers only for changed inputs. Next eligible order from existing 78-order manifest, not another queue. Final R01/R02/R03 after canonical same-C proofs.
handoff_rule: per output: real identity/branch/lease/source preimage+postimage/tree, frozen family digests, contracts, exports/fragment, actual test request/result vs NOT_RUN, blockers/owner, tests impact and consumer ACK. No fabricated model/session/run/job.
